description: Freshly generated, simplified pixel-art sources for the velodrome and laundry kitten concepts. Each transparent 2x2 sprite atlas has one hero pose retained from its top-left cell and detail sprites retained from the full bottom row. Crops preserve alpha and are not resampled; downstream imports should use nearest-neighbor scaling only.

background.prompt: Create a brand-new, clean pixel-art velodrome background, composed as if every visible shape were deliberately placed on a 128×128 pixel grid. Square 8-bit game background. Simple indoor cycling velodrome. Upper 0–22%: only a few chunky grandstand blocks and tiny coral pennants near the top corners. Keep a broad, quiet dark navy/cobalt clock band across y=25–67%, with no objects, lettering, highlights, or decoration inside it. Lower 70–100%: a bold cobalt banked cycling track curving across the bottom with one broad coral lane stripe; leave y=72–96% visually clear as the rider placement area. Intentional high-quality 8-bit game art; square pixel clusters, crisp hard edges, stepped curves, flat fills, clean readable silhouettes. Exact square, full-bleed background, straight-on side view of the track. Palette limited to 8–12 opaque colors, mainly cobalt and deep navy, coral, with a few pale cyan and warm cream accents. One or two flat shades per material; no texture detail. Background only; no people, bicycles, text, logos, numerals, UI, or watermark. Avoid fine textures, dithering, gradients, lighting effects, antialiasing, smoothing, blur, noise, complex scenery, photorealism, extra lane marks, or clutter.

sprite_atlas.crop: Actor: complete cyclist pose isolated from top-left atlas cell, crop (18,153,631,766), output 613×613 RGBA. Detail: full bottom row (0,627,1254,1254), retaining both chevron groups. Crops preserve alpha without resampling.

Top-right: same cyclist and bicycle, same design and scale, facing right in a second pedal pose with legs slightly changed. Bottom-left: a small group of three chunky lime-green speed chevrons pointing right. Bottom-right: a second small group of three chunky lime-green speed chevrons pointing right, same design, slightly wider spacing. Align sprite groups to an invisible quadrant grid; each group centered and fully visible with generous transparent margins; clear gutters. Intentional high-quality 8-bit game sprite; hard square pixel clusters, flat fills, stepped wheel circles, crisp silhouette, no outline finer than one logical pixel. Use only 8–10 flat opaque colors plus full transparency: cobalt, deep navy, coral, cream, muted skin tone, lime. One simple shadow shade at most per object. Real transparent pixels, no painted backdrop or checkerboard; no floor or cast shadow, text, logos, UI, watermark, extra characters, extra props, or touching/cropped objects. Avoid fine texture, dithering, noise, antialiasing, smoothing, blur, glows, photorealism, gradients, clutter, fuzzy edges, decorative scenery.
